# Northmind

## Algorithmic football possession

More Than a Hack 2027 | Technical report | 17 November 2026

**Submission contract.** Infer possession for each BAR-ATH video frame and produce **199,319 rows**, each with a video index and an **H, A, D or X** label. Labels are generated by code, without manual correction. The final candidate is `northmind_sequence`; its local receipt preserves the recipe.

## 1. Method

The system combines ball-player geometry, automatic tactical signals and evidence learned from external matches. Geometry compares ball distances to players on both teams. Confidence decreases during fast, straight ball flight: proximity to a trajectory alone does not establish control. Official automatic Smart Tagging supplies a team prior and restart signals; geometric rules identify stoppages.

| Stage | Operation |
|---|---|
| Observe | Automatic ATD positions and Smart Tagging; process halves and playing blocks separately. |
| Estimate | Ball-player geometry and tactical priors, alongside an external neural ensemble. |
| Combine | Invert four-view transformations, average evidence and weight both external folds equally. |
| Decode | Adaptive H/A switch penalties, followed by bounded local filtering and geometry-aligned transitions. |
| Export | Preserve the candidate's reference D mask; write the indexed H/A/D/X CSV. |

**External neural evidence.** A Set Transformer and temporal convolutional network (TCN) heads provide learned evidence. Transfer combines folds **0 and 6**, teacher seeds **2027 and 2028**, and local and multiscale heads: **eight checkpoints** in total. Scale-selective fusion parameters are recovered from recorded, sealed external selections; they are not retuned to BAR-ATH.

Each member is evaluated through four views: identity, team swap, spatial reflection and their combination. Predictions are mapped back before averaging. This imposes transformation consistency; it does not establish an understanding of passes or control.

**Temporal decisions.** The decoder combines neural evidence with geometry and tactical priors. The neural weight is **0.25 with an observation** and **0.45 without one**. Dynamic programming penalizes H/A changes with a cost adapted to evidence strength. A bounded filter removes local oscillations and aligns transitions with geometry. Halves and playing blocks are processed separately.

## 2. Assets, training and possession rules

| Source | Role |
|---|---|
| Official BAR-ATH automatic ATD tracking | Ball/player positions, temporal alignment and geometry. |
| Official BAR-ATH automatic Smart Tagging | Team prior and restart flags; not human possession labels. |
| Public IDSSE with provider annotations | External model training and selection; not BAR-ATH labels. |
| Five minutes of public BAR-ATH ground truth | Historical diagnostic evaluation after generation, without a parameter sweep. |

Checkpoints derive from [pysport/idsse-data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/pysport/idsse-data), pinned to revision `a715a38dfbaf5f58e431727c2b78d174101a703c`. The source is declared **CC-BY-4.0** in `configs/external_sources.json`; attribution is retained in the artifact manifest. Repository code uses **MIT**, which does not replace data conditions or model attribution requirements.

The available IDSSE corpus contains seven matches: **J03WMX, J03WN1, J03WOH, J03WOY, J03WPY, J03WQQ and J03WR9**. Training and validation use the recorded partitions for folds 0/6; these seven matches are not presented as one training set. The pinned revision and model records preserve the exact partitions. Annotations were distributed by the provider; Northmind added no human labels and did not independently verify each provider annotator's identity.

**Target boundaries.** No private ground truth or other corrected BAR-ATH possession source is used. No human BAR-ATH labels are created to produce the CSV. Video, homography and pose are absent from final inference. The SkillCorner audit did not produce a validated H/A/D cohort incorporated into this recipe. Pass-coordination and actor-continuity pilots did not establish sufficient improvement and are excluded. Match assets and restricted derivatives remain local.

- **H / A:** home/away team control, using geometric, tactical and temporal evidence. Isolated proximity does not determine a change.
- **Loose balls, flights and contests:** reduce local confidence and favor continuity until evidence supports a change. The system does not independently classify every football action.
- **D:** the tracking reference can fall back to dead ball when its observation window has no team evidence. Geometry additionally detects out-of-play or stationary, unattended balls. Quick-restart tags suppress false out-of-play cues. Missing tracking alone does not prove a stoppage.
- **X:** frames outside video blocks corresponding to play. This mask is built without ground truth.

**Variants.** `northmind_sequence` preserves the geometric/tactical reference D mask. An alternative, `northmind_sequence_bridged`, can join D gaps up to **125 frames (5 seconds at 25 fps)** when both sides belong to the same team and no geometric stoppage protection applies. Joining occurs within each block, before and after decoding. Effective parameters are in `possession/inference.py` and `possession/sequence_decoding.py`, not inferred from the submitted CSV.

## 3. Evidence and limitations

| Published external IDSSE test reference | Value |
|---|---|
| Clean spellF1 | **0.51937** |
| Robust objective | **0.47719** |

These scores describe the recorded **external reference**. They are neither a BAR-ATH score nor an independent evaluation of the final four-view transfer. The robust objective is **0.5 clean + 0.25 missing40_5s + 0.25 missing40_15s**, a weighted objective rather than a worst-case score. Final four-view transfer improved some validation comparators, but did not exceed all criteria in both folds.

**No quantified target improvement is claimed.** Format, provenance and reproducibility checks establish technical integrity, not predictive accuracy. Public coverage of the target match is limited; repeated adaptation to that coverage risks overfitting.

Occlusions, tracking and tagging errors, contests and ambiguous restarts can cause errors. Temporal continuity can erase short possessions. The optional bridged variant can absorb genuine stoppages. Loose-ball continuity is a decision policy, not direct proof of which player or team controls the ball.

**Domain transfer remains unresolved.** IDSSE and BAR-ATH differ in domain. Four transformed views enforce consistency under those transformations, but do not prove football understanding. The recorded external test results should not be interpreted as a measurement of final target performance. Further work should prioritize independent evaluation and match diversity before adding rules.

**Additional external validation, 17 November.** Control-memory and learned live/dead alternatives were tested without target labels or video. Neither passed every predeclared guard. Learned live/dead improved the robust objective in both previously seen validation folds, but reduced short-possession recall in some conditions. It remains an experimental alternative; its results are not scores for the submitted recipe or for BAR-ATH.

## What the checks establish

- **Prediction integrity:** valid output structure, provenance and matching hashes across repeated generations.
- **Local reproducibility:** complete inference repeated without a pre-existing target feature cache.
- **Windows relocation:** a clean source/model copy ran from a different root on the same Windows host.
- **Environment reconstruction:** a new isolated Python environment on that same host reproduced both CSVs after the documented installation repair.

These checks do not establish Linux compatibility, portability to another host, or a target accuracy score. The four-view inference procedure and the external test reference cover different evaluation scopes. Neither substitutes for an independent evaluation of the final recipe.

## 4. Reproduction and delivery

Follow the delivery repository's `README.md`: install the pinned environment, restore the public model capsule after checking its manifest and SHA-256, and prepare the official data package locally. Then run:

```text
python -m scripts.run_local restore-submission-assets
python -m scripts.run_local prepare-final-submission
```

**Verified runtime.** Python **3.13.17**, with NumPy **2.2.6**, pandas **2.2.3**, PyTorch **2.10.0+cpu**, python-dateutil **3.0.0**, numba **0.61.2**, llvmlite **0.44.0** and certifi **2025.10.5**. The complete dependency pins, including transitive packages, are in `requirements-submission.txt` in the public repository.

The final entry point loads no ground truth and prints only **OK/FAILED**. It writes `evaluation/reports/final-delivery/Northmind.csv`; the same folder contains a private `manifest.json` with variant, configuration, provenance and checks. `Northmind-fallback.csv` is retained as the reserve.

**Recorded reproduction, 16 November.** Two generations from ATD, without reusing the feature cache, produced byte-identical valid CSVs, confirmed by SHA-256. The checks covered **66 capsule files** and **eight portability tests**. A clean copy of source and models in a different Windows root, with no pre-existing target cache, completed two full generations: candidate and reserve CSVs matched the original root byte for byte.

A further run used a new isolated **Python 3.13.17** environment in the new root on the **same Windows host**. Two valid generations again matched both original CSVs byte for byte. The full `pip install -r` command failed; installation required completing official PyPI wheels for **numba, llvmlite and certifi**, verified by SHA-256. `pip check` then passed. This is not a claim that the single requirements command succeeded, or that Linux or another host was tested.

**Restoration limits.** Historical capsules contain absolute Windows paths and sealed sources. Restoration resolves relocated paths without altering records or accepting content changes. The new-root checks support that Windows relocation, including reconstruction through the documented installation procedure. Another operating system or host needs additional checks.

**Public handoff.** The [public source repository](https://github.com/ismahers/northmind-submission-2027) and [submission-v1 model Release](https://github.com/ismahers/northmind-submission-2027/releases/tag/submission-v1) were verified through anonymous access and SHA-256 checking of the ZIP. Model restoration and installation instructions are in that repository. Logs, target predictions, match assets and restricted derivatives are not published. Local provenance and target outputs remain private.
